description: This file defines device-specific build configurations and utilities for Ubiquiti UBNT devices in an OpenWrt build system, including variable definitions, build functions, and device profiles.

methods.name: Build/mkubntimage
methods.description: Builds a Ubiquiti firmware image with specific header and versioning information.

methods.name: Build/mkubntimage2
methods.description: Creates a second firmware image variant with partitioning and header specifications.

methods.name: Build/mkubntimage-split
methods.description: Splits large images into 1024k chunks, processes each, and reassembles them.
